subtitle: Port & Sherry is at the top of the Chapel tower. Probably.
intro: Left/right or A/D to steer. On a phone tilt, or hold the left or right side
restart: Click, tap or Space to climb again
shouts: Have you got your University Card?
Only Fellows walk on the lawn!
BA Table is Tuesdays and Fridays!
Your parcel is at the Great Gate.
facts: Port & Sherry is in the SBR after hall on Fridays, GBP1.50 a glass.
The SBR also serves port and sherry before and after BA Table.
BA Table is on Tuesdays and Fridays in term.
The SBR is in I2, First Court: through the Great Gate and turn left.
The Chapel was designed by George Gilbert Scott and finished in 1869.
The Chapel tower is about 49 m (163 ft) tall.
Choral Evensong is at 6.30 pm, Tuesday to Sunday.
The Porters' Lodge is at the Great Gate. They know where you are.
The Samuel Butler Room was founded in 1960.
Samuel Butler was at St John's from 1854 to 1858.
The SBR has a TV with a Wii, a pool table, a piano and board games.
Formal Hall can be booked through UPay.

milestones.text: Top of the Chapel tower! The port is not here either.
Higher than Ely Cathedral. Still no sherry.
Cloud level. A Porter is already up here.
Space. The Porters' Lodge has a branch office.

fell: Fell back into Chapel Court. The sherry is gone.
Missed the bench. Landed in the Buttery queue.
Down you go. A Porter asks if you are a member of College.
Gravity wins. It is a Fellow.
porter: Caught by a Porter. Escorted off the premises.
A Porter took your name. And your sherry.
Collared. The Dean will hear about this.
Porter got you. Port & Sherry is cancelled for you this term.
